## Context
Discovered while debugging grindable-deviant-angwantibo. `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py::_collect_node_ids` launches a real nested pytest collection subprocess without `--basetemp`. The confirmed sibling mechanism is pytest session shutdown traversing the shared numbered temp root in `cleanup_numbered_dir`/`rmtree`, which can delete or stall on another run temp tree. The fixed `_store_isolation` helper does not cover this independent caller.

## Plan
- Add a RED regression that gives the nested collection subprocess a poisoned shared numbered temp root and proves a pre-existing sentinel survives unchanged.
- Pass a caller-owned private `--basetemp` directory to `_collect_node_ids` without changing its collection selection, stdout parsing, return-code contract, or timeout.
- Prove GREEN, seed the omitted-basetemp mutation back to RED, and run focused plus repository gates.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The regression fails on the current implementation because nested collection removes or traverses the shared numbered-root sentinel.
- [x] `_collect_node_ids` runs nested pytest with a private basetemp owned by the caller.
- [x] The held-out regression passes and the exact-defect mutation returns it to RED.
- [x] Existing workflow-parity tests pass.
- [x] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test` pass.
